parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate the period of a pendulum. Refer to Fig. 1.1 and Fig. 1.2. Fig. 1.1 Fig. 1.2 A pendulum has been set up for you as shown in Fig. 1.1. Do not change the height of the support.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) • Adjust the length of the pendulum until the distance d measured from the bottom of the support to the centre of the bob is 90.0 cm. • Displace the bob slightly and release it so that it swings. Fig. 1.2 shows one complete oscillation of the pendulum. • Measure, and record in Table 1.1, the time t for 10 complete oscillations. • Calculate, and record in Table 1.1, the period T of the pendulum. The period is the time for one complete oscillation. • Calculate T 2 and record in Table 1.1. [2] Table 1.1 d / cm t / s T / s T 2 / s 2 90.0 45.0

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Repeat the procedure in (a) using a distance d = 45.0 cm. [3]
